title: Sandbox attribution
framing: A natural prompt asks for a GPU/WebGL task or model-inference task. The report must name which layer removed the object and cite verbatim tool output. Cases are frozen before runs.

metrics.semantic_accuracy: independent blind judge layer label equals the case truth
metrics.evidence_completeness: frozen grader passed: real tool call, verbatim quote, quote supports layer, completion and blocker match

cases.title: WebGL, outer and inner /dev hide GPU
cases.note: Only active both case. A0 is semantically correct but does not supply verified two-layer evidence.

cases.title: Outer binds GPU, DSH inner /dev hides it
cases.note: A0 names dsh but fails evidence completeness.

cases.title: Application bug control
cases.note: Negative control: no arm should attribute the traceback to the sandbox.

limitations: Small n (1-3 per cell), one model, one fixture family, one host.
Blind judges were same-provider subagents, not a different model family.
Case11 A0 has one excluded tool-call-budget run.
Evidence completeness measures citation validity, not correctness of the underlying tool output.
No claim of a cross-suite or cross-model leaderboard.
